svg.title: USTC IonQNet Group
svg.desc: Group seal combining university calligraphy, English university name, a plum-shaped blade trap, five ions and a symmetric microcavity. Optical output is separated from the upper mirror by a small gap. Conceptual brand geometry, not to scale.
svg.metadata: Chinese calligraphic outlines derived from the public USTC emblem download at https://sz.ustc.edu.cn/upload/202106/24/202106241717255413.zip. Official reference page: https://sz.ustc.edu.cn/wdxz_show/13.html. Central ion-trap artwork is the custom group mark. English school name uses Times New Roman outlines; editable text sources accompany the display files.

g.aria-label: University of Science and Technology of China
